rows.context_and_review_note: Retained obligatory selected-area containment: iqqan ad expresses must; tili agrees with feminine tamnaḍt, whose postverbal attached state is tmnaḍt. The relative passive participle ittu-styn is not an ordinary finite masculine verb and should not be mechanically feminized. akkʷ emphasizes the entire area; g ugns denotes containment without asserting a required inset or strict inequality. PaintDocument.kt:435 permits left/top=0 and right/bottom=bitmap dimensions, provided width and height are positive. Canvas drawing-area wording remains distinct from a source image. This specialized crop check does not forbid the separate canvas-bounds feature from expanding outward.
